notes: Household rules are design guidance, never occupancy limits (fair housing): any household produces a program.
The cultural profile is chosen and edited by the client; household-layer rules never read it.
Counts are per tier; tiers are cumulative programs: required (minimum), preferred (expected), desirable (with slack).

Cultural layer: a profile is only a preset of explicit aspects that the client sees and edits; culture rules read aspects, never the profile label. Without a profile and without aspects no culture rule fires. Culture may add spaces or raise tiers but never removes a space required by the household.

rules.description: Every dwelling has a kitchen
